title: 第1020章 憋屈的秦虎第1019章 混战
content_zh:
“收拾我？”
秦烈闻言，竟是忍不住笑了。
那笑意里，没有半点退缩，反倒透着一股说不出的锋锐与冷意。
还真把他当成那种可以随意揉捏的软柿子了？
秦烈眼神陡然一沉，下一瞬，他周身气势轰然暴涨，赤红色的火焰自他体内疯狂涌出，炽烈、霸道、汹涌，宛如无尽火海在他身后铺展开来。
“焚天仙体，开！”
轰！
随着这四个字落下，秦烈整个人的气息瞬间飙升，赤红火焰缭绕周身，将他衬托得宛如一尊自火中诞生的神明，举手投足之间，都带着焚尽万物的可怕威压。
火光映照之下，他眸若烈阳，发如燃焰，立于虚空，宛如神明降世。
“要想对付我妹夫，先过我这一关！”
秦烈声音不高，却字字如雷，震得周遭空气都在轰鸣。
蛮九荒与祝九炎对视一眼，目光皆是阴沉了几分。
箭在弦上，不得不发。
既然已经出手，那就没有退路可言。
“既然你找死，那就怪不得我了！”蛮九荒森然开口。
话音未落，他所化的梼杌便率先咆哮而出，巨大的兽躯卷着滔天煞气，利爪撕裂长空，直扑秦烈而去。
祝九炎也在同一时间催动赤焰龙鳞兽爆冲而上，凶焰滔天，火浪翻卷，仿佛要将一切都焚成灰烬。
一时间，梼杌与赤焰龙鳞兽双双围攻秦烈，凶威交错，杀气冲霄，战场顿时再度被推向白热化。
而就在此时，秦瑶也动了。
见蛮九荒他们竟然二打一，秦瑶眉眼间瞬间浮现出一抹冷意，再没有半分迟疑，身影一闪，便已飞身上前。

“哥，我来帮你！”
她清叱一声，体内血脉之力疯狂燃烧，下一刻，耀眼的白金色光芒自她周身冲天而起，化作一只神圣而高贵的白金凤凰，双翼展开之际，烈光照耀四方，神焰流转，华丽而强大。
秦瑶直接化身白金凤凰，振翅而起，毫不犹豫地加入了战场。
她那双凤凰之眸清冷而坚定，目光扫过蛮九荒与祝九炎，声音清脆，却带着不容忽视的决然：
“炎哥，你快去炼化火焰，我来帮你拦住他们！”
叶霄炎原本还想开口。
他本来是想说，你哥对付那两个货色完全没问题，根本不需要她也卷进来。
只不过他话还没来得及说出口，秦瑶就已经振翅飞出，强势介入战局，根本不给他插话的机会。
叶霄炎抬起的手顿了顿，随后缓缓放下。
算了。
秦瑶是秦烈的亲妹妹。
既然她愿意出手，自然也不会让她吃亏。
那就……就这样吧。
见秦瑶小姐也已经加入战场，秦虎顿时又生出了几分意动。
他心里清楚，炎族那边的战斗，自己根本插不上手。
那边层次太高，哪怕他曾经也是炎族之中小有名气的天骄，可如今血脉被抽离，实力早已不复当年，别说参与其中，哪怕只是靠近一些，恐怕都要被余波震成重伤。
可这边呢？
这边总该轮得到他吧？
然而，理想很美好，现实却很残酷。
就在秦虎刚刚生出念头，准备再次冲入战团之时，一只手却再次按在了他的肩头，将他硬生生拦了下来。

出手之人，正是叶霄炎。
content_en:
"Take care of me?"
When Qin Lie heard this, he couldn't help but laugh.
There was no flinching in that smile, but an indescribable sharpness and coldness.
Do you really think of him as the kind of soft persimmon you can knead at will?
Qin Lie's eyes suddenly darkened, and the next moment, the aura around him suddenly surged, and crimson flames surged out from his body crazily, blazing, domineering, and turbulent, like an endless sea of ​​fire spreading out behind him.
"Burning Heaven Immortal Body, open!"
Boom!
As these four words fell, Qin Lie's aura instantly soared, and red flames swirled around his body, making him look like a god born from the fire. Every move and every move carried the terrifying pressure of burning all things.
Under the light of the fire, his eyes were like the blazing sun, and his hair was like burning flames. He stood in the void, like a god descending into the world.
"If you want to deal with my brother-in-law, you have to get through me first!"
Qin Lie's voice was not loud, but every word was like thunder, making the air around him roar.
Man Jiuhuang and Zhu Jiuyan looked at each other, their eyes a little gloomy.
The arrow is on the string and must be fired.
Now that we have taken action, there is no way out.
"Since you are seeking death, you can't blame me!" Man Jiuhuang said solemnly.
Before he finished speaking, the Tao Zhu he transformed into was the first to roar out. The huge beast's body was filled with evil aura, and its sharp claws tore through the sky, heading straight towards Qin Lie.
Zhu Jiuyan also urged the red flame dragon scale beast to rush upward at the same time. The fierce flames surged into the sky, and the fire waves rolled up, as if they were going to burn everything to ashes.
For a time, both Yongzhu and the Red Flame Dragon Scale Beast besieged Qin Lie, with fierce power and murderous intent, and the battlefield suddenly became intense again.
At this moment, Qin Yao also moved.
Seeing that Man Jiuhuang and the others were fighting two against one, Qin Yao's eyebrows instantly showed a hint of coldness. Without any hesitation, she flew forward in a flash.
"Brother, let me help you!"
She screamed, and the blood power in her body burned crazily. The next moment, dazzling white-gold light rose from her body into the sky, transforming into a sacred and noble platinum phoenix. When her wings were spread, the bright light shone in all directions, and the divine flames circulated, gorgeous and powerful.
Qin Yao transformed into a platinum phoenix, flapped her wings and joined the battlefield without hesitation.
Her phoenix eyes were cold and firm, and her gaze swept over Man Jiuhuang and Zhu Jiuyan. Her voice was crisp, but with a determination that could not be ignored:
"Brother Yan, go and refine the flames quickly, and I'll help you stop them!"
Ye Xiaoyan originally wanted to speak.
He originally wanted to say that your brother had no problem dealing with those two guys, and there was no need for her to get involved.
But before he could say anything, Qin Yao had already fluttered out and intervened in the battle forcefully, without giving him a chance to interrupt.
Ye Xiaoyan's raised hand paused, and then slowly lowered it.
never mind.
Qin Yao is Qin Lie's biological sister.
Since she is willing to take action, she will not suffer any loss.
Then...that's it.
Seeing that Miss Qin Yao had also joined the battlefield, Qin Hu suddenly felt a little moved.
He knew in his heart that he couldn't get involved in the battle on the Yan Clan's side.
The level there is too high. Even though he was once a well-known genius among the Yan clan, but now that his bloodline has been taken away, his strength is no longer what it used to be. Let alone participating in it, even if he is just close, he will probably be seriously injured by the aftermath.
But what about here?
It's his turn here, right?
However, the ideal is beautiful, but the reality is cruel.
Just when Qin Hu had the idea to rush into the battle group again, a hand pressed on his shoulder again, stopping him abruptly.
The person who took action was Ye Xiaoyan.
